prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a high fidelity desktop app settings design comp for JevClean, in wide landscape around 1440 by 1000. Render the actual flat web app interface edge to edge with NO browser window, device, desk, mockup frame or perspective. This is a useful working settings screen, not marketing or art. The established direction is a refined light Apple-native-inspired utility. Local system SF Pro-like sans, legible Chinese typography 14-16px body, 24px main title; pale grey-green ground #f5f7f6, near-white #fdfefd content, text #202a25, muted #596a60, green #24634a, selection #e8f2ec, subtle hairlines #dbe3de. Use standard native-like inputs, square checkboxes and ordinary buttons, 8px control corners. No gradients, decorative photos, glass, giant cards or charts.
Top bar 64px high: small existing green square J then “JevClean” left; “本机运行” and “user@example.com” right with button “返回邮件”. Below top bar, centered content max width 1050px with a plain heading “设置” and a standard compact horizontal tab navigation: “邮箱与 API”, active green “规则”, “隐私与日志”. Below it a clearly aligned header “整理规则”, subtitle “用自然语言描述条件，每条规则选择一个动作。” and a small plus-icon button “添加规则” on the right.
Main content is a refined LIST of four natural-language rules, not an icon-card grid. Every row has a square enabled checkbox at left, rule name bold, one concise condition excerpt under it, and right-aligned single-action dropdown labelled “命中后执行” with value “删除”, plus a small “编辑” button. Row 1 “广告推广”, checked, excerpt “清理促销、试用推荐、厂商公开课或峰会的营销邀请。” Row 2 “过期验证码”, checked, expanded in edit mode: a labelled “规则名称” input with value “过期验证码”; below it a labelled “用自然语言描述” textarea of 4 readable lines containing “清理已经失效的一次性登录、注册或身份验证的验证码邮件。以正文明确的有效期或截止时间为准；未注明时，仅清理收到超过24小时的邮件。保留恢复码、长期有效的激活码，以及独立账号安全告警。” Its only action dropdown “命中后执行” value “删除”; editing buttons “完成编辑” and subdued red text “删除规则”. Do not repeat the action dropdown twice. Row 3 “过期活动”, checked, excerpt “清理已过期的活动邀请，保留门票与报名成功凭证。” Row 4 “陈旧通知”, unchecked, quiet muted text, excerpt “清理超过30天的自动通知，保留私信和需要处理的事项。”
Below list a collapsed ordinary disclosure “操作文件夹” with small helper “垃圾箱与归档目录自动识别，必要时手动设置。” Bottom area: plain hint “有未保存的修改。开始分析时会自动保存。” and green primary button “保存修改”. Footer small links “隐私与本地数据”, “操作日志”, “退出本地服务”. Strong information hierarchy, aligned fields, 24px breathing space, concise descriptions that expand on edit, no full-screen dense paragraph dump. The screen must make the natural-language rule and exactly one mail action obvious. Never show the word “建议”. All data is fictional.
